headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 15, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins 7-0, with Zack Wheeler pitching 6.0 innings and striking out 9 batters. The Washington Nationals secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Dylan Crews hitting a crucial home run. The St. Louis Cardinals shut out the San Diego Padres 3-0, with Dustin May earning the win.

Several players have been placed on injured lists, including Brad Keller of the Philadelphia Phillies, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right forearm tendinitis. The Kansas City Royals have also been impacted, with Carlos Estévez being placed on the 60-day injured list.

The Kansas City Royals made a trade, acquiring RHP Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for RHP Denis Samudio and cash.

top_news.title: **Phillies Shut Down Marlins 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, winning 7-0 behind a strong performance from Zack Wheeler. Wheeler pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Dylan Crews leading the charge at the plate. Crews hit a crucial home run, scoring two runs and driving in three, while Andrew Alvarez pitched 4 strong innings with 5 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Mets Suffer Shutout Loss to Reds**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets fell to the Cincinnati Reds 12-0, marking a tough outing for the team. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with 2 home runs and 6 RBIs, while Chase Burns earned the win with 5 scoreless innings.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Shut Out Padres 3-0**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a shutout victory over the San Diego Padres, with Dustin May earning the win after pitching 9.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Brad Keller Placed on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Philadelphia Phillies right-handed pitcher Brad Keller has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right forearm tendinitis, effective retroactive to June 14, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Seabold in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals made a move on June 15, 2026, acquiring RHP Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for RHP Denis Samudio and cash.
